_doc: The 8 mm slot of Motedis' I-type profiles (40 mm series). Motedis prints the opening and the depth; it sells the section as I-type, made to match item's Line 8 groove, so the lip and the cavity's width are item's figures, marked community until a bar is measured. The floor and flanks are item's as scaled off its drawing.
name: slot-8-motedis-i

opening.rule: Slot width, "8" on the data picture ("Nutbreite: 8 mm" on the page)
opening.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-40x40L-I-Typ-Nut-8", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-40x40L-I-Typ-Nut-8

lip_thickness.rule: Lip thickness: Motedis prints none. item's figure for the groove this is made to match (slot-8-item-light)
lip_thickness.source: slot-8-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: Motedis prints none. item's figure (slot-8-item-light)
cavity_width.source: slot-8-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

cavity_depth.rule: Slot depth, "12,25" on the data picture (the page's text rounds it: "Nuttiefe: 12 mm")
cavity_depth.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-40x40L-I-Typ-Nut-8", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-40x40L-I-Typ-Nut-8

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor: as slot-8-item-light, itself scaled off item's drawing
floor_width.source: slot-8-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as slot-8-item-light
flank_angle.source: slot-8-item-light rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

nut_family.rule: Sold as I-type: it takes nuts made for item's Line 8 groove
nut_family.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-40x40L-I-Typ-Nut-8", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-40x40L-I-Typ-Nut-8
